comparison_rule: Metrics are comparable only when dataset/query/judgment definitions permit comparison. Match cutoff, eligibility, representation/model and timing boundary as appropriate.

workloads.purpose: Narrow required-evidence/context/stub regressions; no complete graded ranking universe.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Compare preserved V0-V2 routes on the same two needs, eligibility and context policy; execution/timing boundary must match.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: Do not equate two-task evidence success with later macro NDCG or general answer quality.

workloads.purpose: Compare overlap/BM25/WAND and Chapter 10 exact binary cosine on an inspected lexical workload.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Within this workload compare routes at matched cutoff/eligibility/model/input and declared context; geometric exact-oracle comparisons also require the same vectors.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No improvement sequence across Chapter 09, 11, 12 or stress workloads; no model gain from geometry alone.

workloads.purpose: Frozen encoder versus BM25 on new authored embedding probes; Chapter 13 uses it for materialization parity.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Within this workload compare routes at matched cutoff/eligibility/model/input and declared context; geometric exact-oracle comparisons also require the same vectors.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No improvement sequence across Chapter 09, 11, 12 or stress workloads; no model gain from geometry alone.

workloads.purpose: Same-model exact oracle versus lexical and ANN variants on inspected stress slices; geometric and judged recall stay separate.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Within this workload compare routes at matched cutoff/eligibility/model/input and declared context; geometric exact-oracle comparisons also require the same vectors. workloads.purpose: Query-adapter training and dev selection followed by document-target/new-query holdout; source families overlap.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Frozen/adapted/BM25 on the same 11 test queries after checkpoint freeze; compare validation separately.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: Do not compare 25 queries as a single fully judged set, reuse test for selection, or infer unseen-family/domain transfer.

workloads.purpose: Teach dev-select-freeze-test parameter methodology with separate authored questions.

workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: Do not treat original inspected Chapter 09 cases as this held-out test; do not compare this score with original Chapter 09 as an engine improvement.

workloads.purpose: Decompose coarse-list omissions, PQ distortion and bounded refinement on fixed vectors. Chapter 17 reuses identical rows/queries for graph ANN and fresh exact/IVF-Flat controls.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Within same trained index/query roster compare probe/mode/refinement at k=2; full-probe Flat oracle parity. Chapter 17 geometric oracles match historical IDs; compare fresh matched timings only, with traced search boundaries and index identities explicit.

workloads.distribution_clarification: The existing generator selects a stored row independently for each query coordinate, adds Gaussian noise sigma=.08 and normalizes. Legacy planted-16-v1 is an opaque identity label; no single planted neighbor is asserted. Historical bytes/results remain unchanged.

workloads.purpose: Hand-search failure and recovery by widening a bounded retained pool; actual frontier snapshots.

workloads.purpose: Compare static predicate-specific exact index with public-tag post-shortlist filtering at depths8/32; inspect true filtered-oracle recall and underfill. All vectors already authorized.

workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No ACL safety claim for postfiltering; no human relevance/answer/generalization gain; stride8 and64 define different eligible-oracle populations.

workloads.purpose: Bounded page coalescing and beam-entry residency with oldest-first LRU; actual logical page requests and cache transitions.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Replay identical page map, ordered beams, initial cache and capacity to verify logical decisions.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No DiskANN execution, measured SSD latency, storage throughput, geometric or judged retrieval gain; the second beam starts with changed cache state.

workloads.purpose: Frozen source-bound span preservation and traceability across flat/structured ingestion, plus unchanged lexical source diagnostic. Nine descriptors; seven licensed eligible inputs.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Same bytes, policies, eight probes, source-span requirements and diagnostic; adapter/normalization bundle changes. Source hit@1 uses alias-aware source IDs, not block qrels.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No longitudinal improvement against V0/V3/V4 or ANN; no complete graded qrels, held-out generalization, OCR accuracy, generation or service-latency claim.

workloads.purpose: Compare six source-preserving boundary configurations plus shared-child full-parent expansion under exact frozen dense top3 and a whole-unit80 encoder-WordPiece context budget. Ten positive/two no-evidence inspected questions,18 required spans.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Same canonical/source/policy/alias roster, questions, independent required spans, frozen model/body input, exact scorer,k3 and budget80. Atom recall is macro over ten positives; duplicate context is mean over all twelve. Parent mode reuses word24 index.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No improvement against Chapter19 extraction or V3/V4 metrics; no train/dev/test/production/generalization, answer correctness, generator token budget, OCR or learned semantic/RAPTOR/late-chunking claim.

workloads.purpose: Authorization-first typed predicates, exact eligible oracle and bounded task postfilters. 17 descriptors,15 accepted; reader A10/B4,one admin-only;9 positive/3 empty questions,11 relevant memberships in108 reviewed authorized pairs.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Same body-only pinned384 model/typed metadata/principal/queries/qrels/exact scoring/stable ties/k2. Semantic omits task constraints; prefilter and post3/post9 enforce them. Macro relevance recall over9 positives; eligible-oracle recall separate; empty correctness over3. Inherited whole-unit80 encoder-WordPiece context selector measures source availability separately.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: No longitudinal V3/V4/V5 gain, ANN or production latency, authentication/live revocation, train/dev/test/generalization, multilingual model quality, answer-quality/generation/citation/abstention claim. Task postfilter is never ACL enforcement.

workloads.purpose: Exhaustive traversal with/without task-ineligible transit vertices in one already authorized four-node chain.
workloads.valid_comparisons: Same graph,entry,preassigned scores and task membership; final eligible node/frontier events.
workloads.invalid_cross_workload_inferences: Not HNSW,ANN latency,ACL traversal,relevance/generation or longitudinal quality. No train/dev/test.
